title: Route ATLAS-WP-023 and isolate M3.4 delegated workflow
purpose: Teach the central Learn-it Next router to recognize the ATLAS-WP-023 transient user-source admission product branch and prevent the historical M3.4 exact-head workflow from running on unrelated pull requests that only touch shared factory documentation.
invariants: Only the central router, the historical M3.4 workflow guard and CI-WP-014 metadata change.
atlas/ATLAS-WP-023-transient-user-source-admission maps to one dedicated delegated profile.
The ATLAS-WP-023 delegated profile accepts exactly the seven product paths authorized by ATLAS-WP-023.
The ATLAS-WP-023 delegated profile rejects changes to benchmark SourceAdmission, benchmark catalog, factory gate, reliability, release set, canonical kit contract, authoring-v2 and learner runtime.
The M3.4 exact-head job remains unchanged for its exact product branch and all push executions.
The M3.4 exact-head job skips unrelated pull-request branches.
Existing delegated branch mappings and unknown-branch fail-closed behavior remain unchanged.
requiredEvidence: Generic ci-router audit accepts this CI-only route change.
Delegated route requires exactly the seven ATLAS-WP-023 product paths and exact work-package authority.
M3.4 workflow skips CI-WP-014 and ATLAS-WP-023 pull-request branches while retaining push behavior.
After CI-WP-014 merge and product rebase, ATLAS-WP-023 product PR reaches delegated central route PASS and no historical M3.4 false failure.
adversarialTests: Unknown branch still reaches generic ci-router and requires a workflow audit change.
ATLAS-WP-023 delegated profile rejects non-pull-request execution.
ATLAS-WP-023 delegated profile rejects an unexpected branch.
ATLAS-WP-023 delegated profile rejects path deficit, excess or forbidden upstream authority change.
ATLAS-WP-023 delegated profile rejects work-package baseline that differs from PR base.
M3.4 exact-head job continues to run for atlas/ATLAS-WP-021-m3-4-qualified-release-set.
M3.4 push behavior is not skipped.
independentReview: Repository governance and PR scope gate this CI-only three-file change.
The rebased ATLAS-WP-023 product PR is the acceptance target for the new delegated route.
rollback: Revert the CI-WP-014 three-file change. Product code remains untouched; the central router returns to rejecting ATLAS-WP-023 and the historical M3.4 workflow returns to its prior broad PR trigger.
